HOW TO PLAY

GOAL

Be first across the finish line after the last lap. Win races to earn coins, then spend them in the Garage on faster cars and upgrades.

KEYBOARD

D RIGHTGasA LEFTBrakeW UPMove up a laneS DOWNMove down a laneSPACE SHIFTNitro (hold with gas)

TOUCH

Use the on-screen buttons: GAS to go, BRK to brake, NOS for a nitro boost and UP / DN to change lanes.

TIPS

  • Nitro drains while boosting and refills when you let go.
  • Icy tracks are slippery, so brake before changing lanes.
  • Rivals use nitro and will cut across to block you, so pass them cleanly.
  • Press M to mute and ESC to quit a race.

GARAGE

Buy new cars and upgrade Engine (top speed), Turbo (acceleration) and Tires (handling) with your coins. First place pays a bonus!

2 PLAYER VERSUS

Share one keyboard in split screen. P1: WASD + SPACE nitro. P2: ARROWS + ENTER nitro. Optional AI rivals fill the grid. No coins are paid in versus races.
